name: Slot roll (words or numbers)
visual_intent: One slot in a sentence cycles through options like a mechanical counter (hooks / ads / launched), keeping the rest of the line still so the change is the message.
implementation_summary: A one-line overflow-hidden window as wide as the widest entry over a column of entries; each step tweens the column's yPercent to the entry with back.out overshoot. The window carries an aria-label with all entries.

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (starts on entry 0, lands exactly on entry 2) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
